holdings.name: HDFC Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit for the September 2026 quarter grew to Rs 21,537 crore from Rs 20,383 crore in the June 2026 quarter.
Sashidhar Jagdishan stepped down on October 26, 2026, and Anup Bagchi took charge as MD and CEO on October 27, 2026, with shareholder approval confirmed on November 6, 2026.
HDFC Bank raised fixed deposit interest rates across select tenures.

holdings.why_it_matters: HDFC Bank is the fund's largest single holding at 7.22% and the top contributor over the 3-month period, adding an estimated 0.565% on a 7.83% gain. Its performance significantly influences the fund's 26.6% Financials sector weighting.

watch.text: Monitor operational execution and strategic direction under new MD and CEO Anup Bagchi.

holdings.name: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit expanded to Rs 3,682 crore on sales of Rs 11,340 crore for the quarter ended September 2026.
Adani Ports agreed to acquire European bulk liquid storage operator Evos B.V. for €2.56 billion ($2.9 billion) and incorporated Continental Energy Terminals B.V. in the Netherlands.

expected.text: Brokerages project the Evos B.V. acquisition to be EPS accretive and drive double-digit RoCE by FY30.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 3.69% weight, it is the fund's second-largest contributor over 3 months, generating a 14.35% return and adding an estimated 0.530% to portfolio performance within Industrials (12.2% sector weight).

watch.text: Track regulatory approvals and the completion timeline for the €2.56 billion Evos acquisition.

holdings.name: Reliance Industries Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit reached Rs 29,550 crore on sales of Rs 330,601 crore in the quarter ended September 2026.
S&P reaffirmed Reliance's A- credit rating with a stable outlook for its senior unsecured US dollar notes.
Reliance Consumer expanded into the packaged biscuit market, prompting reactions from incumbent competitors.

holdings.why_it_matters: Representing 2.44% of the fund, the stock declined 1.11% over 3 months and 8.03% over 6 months, acting as a moderate drag within the 5.7% Energy & Utilities allocation.

watch.text: Monitor corporate and operational updates at the CLSA India Forum investor meeting on November 16, 2026.

holdings.name: NTPC Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit jumped 41% year-on-year to Rs 7,351 crore in Q2 FY27 on sales of Rs 54,270 crore, accompanied by a dividend declaration.
SES ESG Research upgraded NTPC's ESG score to 64.6 for FY2025-26.

holdings.why_it_matters: NTPC holds a 2.20% fund weight; despite strong quarterly profit growth, the stock has declined 5.56% over 3 months and 19.57% over 6 months, dampening the Energy & Utilities sleeve.

watch.text: Track execution against capital expenditure milestones and operational power generation targets.

holdings.name: Pearl Global Industries Ltd

what_changed.text: September 2026 quarterly revenue rose to Rs 1,802 crore with net profit advancing to Rs 126 crore.
The company reported H1 FY27 revenue of INR 3,330 crore with PAT up 63.6%, and approved an interim dividend of Rs 5 per share.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 2.18% fund weight in Consumer Discretionary (19.0% sector weight), the stock gained 8.66% over 3 months and 66.86% over 6 months, serving as a primary mid-sized contributor.

watch.text: Monitor cash payouts following the November 5, 2026 record date for the Rs 5 interim dividend.

holdings.name: Axis Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit reached Rs 7,666 crore on revenue of Rs 38,087 crore for the quarter ended September 2026.
The RBI approved the reappointment of Munish Sharda as Executive Director from February 27, 2027 to February 26, 2030.
Axis Bank rolled out festive campaigns offering discounts on home loan processing fees, personal loan rates, and auto loans.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 2.16% weight, Axis Bank reinforces the fund's heavy 26.6% Financials exposure, gaining 6.86% over the 3-month period.

watch.text: Watch retail lending disbursals and loan asset growth generated from the festive campaigns.

holdings.name: ICICI Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit rose to Rs 17,389 crore on revenue of Rs 55,992 crore in the September 2026 quarter.
The Telangana GST appellate authority confirmed a penalty of Rs 6,95,418, which the bank announced it will appeal.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 2.00% fund weight, the stock gained 10.57% over 3 months, contributing an estimated 0.211% to the portfolio's top-performing Financials cluster.

watch.text: Track the outcome of the bank's appeal against the Telangana GST appellate penalty order.

holdings.name: Dr. Lal Pathlabs Ltd

what_changed.text: Revenue for Q2 FY27 rose 19.6% year-on-year to Rs 874 crore while net profit increased 27.5% to Rs 194 crore.
The board declared a second interim dividend of Rs 5 per share and cleared strategic investments of up to Rs 49.5 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 1.98% weight, Dr. Lal Pathlabs represents a stable earner in the Healthcare sleeve (10.8% sector weight), returning 1.99% over 3 months and 19.41% over 6 months.

watch.text: Monitor deployment and return metrics on the approved Rs 49.5 crore strategic investment.

holdings.name: Kotak Mahindra Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit for the September 2026 quarter grew to Rs 5,645 crore on revenue of Rs 19,856 crore.
The Competition Commission of India cleared Kotak Mahindra Bank's acquisition of Deutsche Bank AG's retail, private banking, and wealth management businesses in India.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 1.83% weight, it was the third-largest contributor over 3 months, adding an estimated 0.418% via a 22.84% stock gain, complementing the fund's core private banking basket.

watch.text: Track closing steps and integration timelines for the Deutsche Bank India retail and wealth assets.

holdings.name: Bharti Airtel Ltd

what_changed.text: September 2026 quarterly net profit expanded to Rs 10,710 crore on sales of Rs 60,878 crore.
Bharti Airtel reinstated its Rs 299 mobile tariff plan following analyst observations of subscriber churn after August revisions.
A monitoring agency report verified zero deviation in the deployment of Rs 15,714.47 crore raised from its rights issue calls.

holdings.why_it_matters: Representing 1.80% of the portfolio in Technology (8.2% sector weight), the stock gained 7.52% over 3 months and 14.90% over 1 month, providing steady non-financial performance.

watch.text: Track subscriber churn data and ARPU trends following the re-introduction of the Rs 299 plan.

portfolio.statement: TATA MULTICAP FUND is a Multi Cap strategy with a 93.9% equity allocation, positioned predominantly in Financials (26.6%) and Consumer Discretionary (19.0%), with top 10 holdings accounting for 27.5% of assets.
interp: Performance over the recent 3-month period was sustained by large private banks and industrial logistics, which delivered positive gains despite fund-level returns of -2.91%.
Drags from individual Consumer Staples and Healthcare holdings partially neutralized the contributions from core banking names.
portfolio.line: Heavy allocations to private financial leaders and infrastructure assets drove positive stock-level contributions despite broader fund softness over 3 months.

drivers.text: HDFC Bank added an estimated 0.565% to performance, backed by a 7.83% 3-month stock return and quarterly net profit rising to Rs 21,537 crore.
Adani Ports contributed an estimated 0.530% with a 14.35% return following steady quarterly results and the announced €2.56 billion Evos B.V. acquisition.

themes.text: Substantial capital deployed across large private banks benefiting from steady net profit expansion and strategic portfolio acquisitions.

themes.title: Global Infrastructure and Transport Scaling

macro.why: Acquisitions of key European storage facilities expose fund industrials to European cargo flows and international commodity movements.

could_change.title: Executive Succession at HDFC Bank
could_change.text: The transition of the MD & CEO position to Anup Bagchi could adjust operational and credit growth strategies at the fund's largest position.

could_change.title: Telecom Plan Restructuring
could_change.text: Bharti Airtel's decision to reinstate the Rs 299 plan after tariff changes could shift subscriber churn and average revenue metrics.

portfolio.risk_note: With Financials representing 26.6% of the portfolio, the fund is exposed to systemic interest rate shifts, regulatory updates from the RBI, and credit cost fluctuations.
